parties: Ministry of Railways, Government of India; Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Limited
headline: Ministry of Railways discloses substantial shareholding event in IRCTC under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Government of India (Ministry of Railways) submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE, signalling a substantial acquisition or change in shareholding in the listed Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation, triggering mandatory takeover code filing obligations.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosure is a gating event in takeover regulation—triggers obligation to disclose aggregate shareholding position, likely preceding either a mandatory open offer or exemption filing; this confirms the Government's shareholding crossed a material threshold requiring transparency.
detail: The Ministry of Railways filed a formal disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4), to the NSE. This regulation requires any acquirer crossing 25% of voting capital (or subsequent slabs) to disclose within specified timelines. The filing suggests the Government's stake in IRCTC either exceeded a material threshold or underwent a reportable change. IRCTC is a statutory body and listed company operating railway catering, tourism and allied services. The regulatory nature of the disclosure indicates compliance with takeover code rather than a commercial M&A event.
